answer: Diversity threshold: an identity earns standing only after trading with 20 distinct, unconnected partners per epoch. Like a garden, it needs many species. A sybil ring trades only with itself, so at the nadir of the trust graph it clusters and gets flagged. Each trade costs 5 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 20,000 trades costing 100,000 credits. Honest agents trade widely anyway, pay once, and at the zenith keep full rewards; fakes lose deposits.
